task.title: Publish a DITA map to PDF in AEM Guides
task.shortdesc: Use a PDF output preset to generate a PDF for an entire DITA map.

prereq.p: You have access to an AEM Guides instance and a DITA map to publish.

context.p: In AEM Guides, you publish a map by selecting a PDF output preset and running the publish job from the map dashboard.

step.cmd: Open the DITA map in AEM Guides and go to the map dashboard.
Select the PDF output preset you want to use for publishing.
Choose how you want PDFs generated for the map.

chrow.choption: Generate one PDF for the map
chrow.chdesc: Creates a single PDF that contains the content of the entire DITA map.

chrow.choption: Generate separate PDF for each topic
chrow.chdesc: If enabled in the preset, AEM Guides also creates a PDF per topic and lets you specify a split output path.

step.cmd: Run the publish action for PDF and wait for the job to complete.

result.p: The generated PDF output is available from the publish results for the map.
